facts.h2: Everything you'll love, at a glance
facts.intro: Move in with just a suitcase, or let it keep earning while you're away.
list: No agency fees. Sold by owner.
South Beach Jacó, the quiet end of the bay
Active vacation rental. Figures on request.

highlights.h2: Why people fall for this place
items: Your own calm stretch of sea
At the south end of Playa Jacó, the beach curves into a bay. The waves soften, and you'll often have the sand almost to yourself.
Just 21 homes share the building. The pool is quiet, the rooftop is rarely busy, and people say hello.
A relaxed, leafy street away from the nightlife. Jacó's restaurants and shops are only minutes away.
A home that pays its way
Guests already love staying here, and the reviews show it. Ask for the rental figures.

view.p1: Slide open the glass wall and the living room becomes part of the terrace. Palms, then ocean, then endless sky.
view.p2: In the evening, the light turns gold, then pink, and the whole room glows with it. Most nights, the sunset is the show.

home.h2: Cook with the ocean in view
home.p: Kitchen, dining and living flow into one bright room that opens to the terrace. Pull up a stool at the quartz island, with hand-painted tiles behind you and the sea ahead. The washer and dryer are tucked away in their own corner.
home.caption: Fully furnished. Just bring your suitcase.

rooms.intro: One bedroom looks out to the ocean, the other into the green hills. Both stay cool and quiet, made up and ready for you.
cards: Wake up to the sound of the sea. Slide the full-height door open and step straight onto the terrace.
Two twin beds and a desk, looking into the trees. Perfect for kids, guests or working from home.
Walk-in rain showers and clean, simple finishes. Come up from the beach and rinse off the salt.

terrace.h2: Your front-row seat on the Pacific
terrace.line: Morning coffee, sunset drinks, and scarlet macaws flying past most days.

building.h2: A small building with a big sense of calm
building.p: Only 21 homes share Sunset Boulevard. Swim beside the stone waterfall wall, read in the shaded lounge by the pool, then ride the elevator back up. Everything is quiet and well looked after.

rooftop.line: The shared rooftop looks out over the whole bay. Bring a drink, find a chair and stay until the stars come out.

included.h2: Move in with just a suitcase
included.intro: Everything in the home stays: furniture, linens, kitchenware, the lot.
items: From the living room, main bedroom and terrace

location.h2: South Beach Jacó: peaceful, and close to everything
location.p1: The condo sits where Playa Jacó curves into a bay. The sea is calmer here, and the street is easygoing and green.
location.p2: Restaurants, shops and the supermarket in the centre of Jacó are just minutes away. The nightlife stays far enough off that your evenings are quiet.
points: Surf beach, about 10 min by car
National park, about 1 h 15 min south

income.p: Unit 405 is a well-loved Airbnb with a trail of happy guest reviews. Keep renting it out, make it your own, or enjoy a bit of both.
income.fixed: Rental income figures available on request.
income.link: See the Airbnb listing and guest reviews

reviews.scoreLine: out of 5 from 53 Airbnb reviews · Guest favourite, top 10% of homes
items: The sea view is better than the photos. I would live in this place!
Spotless, cozy and well equipped. Without a doubt, the best thing about it is the amazing view with spectacular sunsets. A perfect place to disconnect.
We loved getting to see macaws and iguanas from the balcony, not to mention the fantastic ocean view.
An absolute gem! Just a couple minutes' walk to the beach. You're at the far end of the beach, so it isn't as hectic.
Nice neighborhood at the south end of the beach. Quiet and safe, but close enough to town too.
The building is very secure, with gated parking under the building. The pool area is superb. I would not consider staying anywhere else in Jacó!

contact.h2: Come and see it for yourself
contact.p: $365,000, with no agency fees and owner financing available. Send a message with your questions, plan a viewing or ask for the rental figures. The owner replies personally.
